name: capillaryjs
description: Public workspace for the Capillary reactive core and Capillary UI runtime.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary typecheck && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-viz typecheck && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-ui-demo typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/dummy-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/buildco-control typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/component-gallery typecheck && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/localization-demo typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary test && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-ui test && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-viz test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/dummy-server test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/buildco-control test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/component-gallery test && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/localization-demo test
scripts.test:types: pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary test:types:consumer && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-ui test:types:consumer && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-viz test:types:consumer
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary build && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-ui build && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-viz build && pnpm --filter @capillaryjs/capillary-ui-demo build && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/buildco-control build && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/component-gallery build && pnpm --filter @sylwellsoftware/localization-demo build
scripts.verify: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:types
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify && pnpm test:browser && pnpm pack:check && pnpm scan:public && node scripts/public-release-preflight.mjs
